market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are a historically strong IPL franchise with a recent title in 2024 and consistent playoff appearances. The base rate for any team in a 10-team league is 10%, but KKR's superior performance suggests a true win probability around 12%, far above the 2% implied by market price, indicating a significant mispricing.
evidence_points: KKR won IPL 2024 and made playoffs in each of the last 4 seasons.
In a 10-team league, even an average team has a 10% chance; KKR is above average.
IPL win probability models typically assign top teams 10-15% preseason win odds, not 2%.
